comment: UNENFORCED legacy scaffold (Phase 0 workstream E). The LIVE fallback authority is now WG-11(b) family-aware routing in scripts/hooks/lib/providers.js (suggestFallbackProvider + PROVIDER_FAMILY) — a quota/outage fallback lands in a DIFFERENT model family, never same-family. This file's per-role policies below still carry PRE-ADR-0007 role keys (reviewer/compliance/qa) and PRE-DISPATCH.md-§8 model ids (gpt-5.5, claude-sonnet-4-6); they are documentation only and no consumer routes off them. The SUNSET individual `gemini` CLI targets were repointed to antigravity (agy) in the 2026-07-20 deep-clean. A full rewrite to the new roster (security-reviewer/frontend-reviewer/qa-reviewer + gpt-5.6/sonnet-5) is deferred with the ADR-0007 scaffold-cleanup. Do not treat the ids below as authoritative.

security-reviewer.rationale: security-reviewer (was redteam) runs adversarial-corpus reasoning; the Gemini lab is the primary, served through the Antigravity `agy` CLI (the individual-tier gemini CLI is SUNSET — deep-clean 2026-07-20). CROSS-FAMILY fallback: a Google-lab outage retries on the GPT lab (openai:gpt-5.6-sol), never another google endpoint (WG-11(b)); a total outage falls through runProvider's provider-level fallback. A SECOND security pass ALWAYS runs on openai:gpt-5.6-sol so security covers two model families. deep_fallback is the Claude hunter lane (claude-opus-4-8) as a last-resort known-good.

reviewer.rationale: GPT-5.5 xhigh is the diversity lens against Claude builders. Falling back to claude-sonnet-4-6 keeps gauntlets moving when codex is unreachable.

qa.rationale: qa runs 13 personas — cost-balanced primary. Haiku fallback keeps per-persona cost predictable on outages.

notes: auth_source_mismatch deliberately does NOT auto-fall-back. The user has set both API key AND OAuth — failing closed surfaces the configuration ambiguity rather than silently using the wrong account.
